_comment: System freshness registry — one asOf date per living system, in-world. tools/check-freshness.py compares each entry against Reputation-Matrix2/data/currentDate.json (house absDay: year*365 + monthIndex*30 + day) and re-verifies it against its source file, then prints every system stalest-first. STANDING ORDER (Reputation-Matrix2/gemini.md): run the check at the start of maintenance work and fold the stalest system into the plan. To track a new system: add label/asOf/source/verify/playbook; set enforced:true only once a playbook exists and the lag is genuinely kept. Never invent outcomes or backdate to make a number move.
